cases.text: An astronomer stands beside a telescope and looks at the moon above it.
An aquarium contains a fish. A child stands beside the aquarium and points at the fish. A cat is below the aquarium.
A cabinet contains a violin. A musician stands to the left of the cabinet and looks at the violin. A chair is to the right of the cabinet, and a clock is above it.
